review_notes: I read the whole target file. I also read the sibling normalized definition and its simp membership lemma in NormalizedSmallOrderCount.lean, and the core PuncturedNormalization lemmas, including the simp lemma mem_originalPuncturedFinsetOfNormalized_iff. I grepped for uses of the transported set and its card lemma. The two downstream sites that manually unfold the definition are GiantOrbit.lean:275-278 and ExplicitPuncturedTransitivity.lean:131-134. The card lemma is used by `rw` at four sites. I could not run Lean, so I make no claim about simp behaviour that was observed. Both proposals are low-risk but untested. The first finding (missing membership lemma) is the stronger one. The second (card lemma not simp) is a smaller ergonomic point.

findings.problem: The normalized and normalized-punctured versions of this set have a @[simp] membership characterization. The transported original-surface set has none. Simp cannot see through the definition, so membership goals about it stall. Downstream proofs fall back to `change x ∈ …` followed by `rw [puncturedMarkoffPointsWithSmallFirstTwoRotationOrders, mem_originalPuncturedFinsetOfNormalized_iff, mem_normalizedPuncturedMarkoffPointsWithSmallFirstTwoRotationOrders_iff]`. That chain depends on the definition's internal structure and is duplicated in two files.
findings.proposed_change: Add right after the definition: `@[simp] theorem mem_puncturedMarkoffPointsWithSmallFirstTwoRotationOrders_iff {p} [Fact p.Prime] [Invertible (3 : ZMod p)] {bound} {x : PuncturedMarkoffSurface (ZMod p)} : x ∈ puncturedMarkoffPointsWithSmallFirstTwoRotationOrders p bound ↔ rotationOrder (puncturedNormalizationEquiv (ZMod p) x).1.u1 < bound ∧ rotationOrder (puncturedNormalizationEquiv (ZMod p) x).1.u2 < bound`. Prove it by `unfold` then `simp`. The right-hand side is the normalized form that the existing simp lemmas already reach. The direction is terminating: it only unfolds a membership atom. Then replace the manual `rw` chains in GiantOrbit.lean and ExplicitPuncturedTransitivity.lean with this lemma.
findings.benefit: This gives the new set the same canonical simp interface as its two siblings. Downstream proofs no longer unfold the definition by hand, and they no longer repeat the two-step rewrite chain. If the definition changes, only one lemma needs updating.

evidence.declaration: manual unfolding in the proof around line 275

findings.problem: This is the canonical reduction of `(puncturedMarkoffPointsWithSmallFirstTwoRotationOrders p bound).card` to the normalized punctured set's card. It is not tagged @[simp], so it is invoked by explicit `rw [puncturedMarkoffPointsWithSmallFirstTwoRotationOrders_card_eq_normalized]` at lines 116, 127 and 139 and in MaximalDivisorLowOrderCount.lean. Its general form, `originalPuncturedFinsetOfNormalized_card`, is also not simp. Since the definition is opaque to simp, no simp-set route reaches this normal form.
findings.proposed_change: Mark the lemma `@[simp]`. Its left-hand side is a specific def application and its right-hand side is a strictly more primitive card, so it cannot loop. Optionally also tag `originalPuncturedFinsetOfNormalized_card` in the core module, which would make the first tag redundant. Then the `rw [...]` steps in the four client proofs can be left to simp.
findings.benefit: Cardinality goals about the transported set normalize to the normalized punctured set without naming the lemma. Cardinality statements then compose with the existing `_card_le_ambient` and `erase_origin` lemmas.
